press_references.value: Space42, Skylo complete successful testing of Direct-to-Device SMS and SOS services

product_launches.description: Space42, in partnership with Skylo Technologies, has successfully tested Direct-to-Device SMS and SOS messaging services over the Thuraya-4 satellite on standard Android devices, validating a 3GPP-compliant NTN platform as a precursor to commercial rollout.

press_references.value: Space42 expands earth observation capabilities as three foresight satellites enter full operation

product_launches.description: Space42 placed its Foresight-3, Foresight-4, and Foresight-5 synthetic aperture radar satellites into full operational service, expanding the Foresight Earth Observation constellation to five SAR satellites feeding its GIQ geospatial intelligence platform.

press_references.value: South Africa Marks New Era in Satellite Connectivity with Space42 Thuraya-4 Launch

product_launches.description: Space42 launched Thuraya-4 satellite connectivity services in South Africa, demonstrating products and outlining future digital transformation initiatives like Map Africa.

press_references.value: Architecting Africa’s Digital Ecosystem Through Satellites and Strategic Alliances

product_launches.description: Space42 confirmed that its Thuraya-4 next-generation mobile satellite, launched in January, is now in commercial operation, enabling new high-speed MSS services via 16 compatible terminals across land, maritime, and aeronautical segments.

press_references.value: Space42 and Gatehouse Satcom Pioneer Direct-to-Device Satellite Connectivity

product_launches.description: Space42, through its subsidiary Thuraya, and Gatehouse Satcom are set to launch Thuraya Direct, a new direct-to-device satellite messaging and IoT service, with commercial deployment planned for Q4 2025.

press_references.value: Space42 expands earth observation constellation, Foresight, with launch of three new SAR satellites

product_launches.description: Space42, in collaboration with ICEYE, successfully launched three new SAR satellites—Foresight-3, Foresight-4, and Foresight-5—into LEO via Exolaunch on SpaceX’s Bandwagon-4 mission, expanding its Foresight EO constellation and enabling 25 cm resolution data for the GIQ platform.

press_references.value: Global Rail Transport Infrastructure Exhibition and Conference 2025 Day Two Accelerates Innovation, Partnerships, and Investment Across the Global Transport Ecosystem

product_launches.description: Space42 announced SAT-Track, a satellite-enabled IoT system for real-time asset visibility, during Global Rail 2025.

press_references.value: Space42 introduces Thuraya Mobile Broadband Hotspot

product_launches.description: Space42 has launched the Thuraya Mobile Broadband Hotspot (MBH), a lightweight, secure satellite broadband terminal designed to provide reliable connectivity in remote areas across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Central Asia. The product targets government, commercial, and maritime users requiring critical communications beyond terrestrial networks.

press_references.value: Space42 delivers resilient H1 2025 performance

product_launches.description: Space42 launched the Thuraya Broadband Hotspot in Q2 2025, expanding its mobile satellite services portfolio.

product.name: Satellite Communications Services
product.description: Satellite connectivity services for government, enterprise, mobility, and broadband applications, delivered through Space42’s satellite communications infrastructure.

product.name: AI-Powered Geospatial Intelligence
product.description: Geospatial intelligence services that combine satellite imagery, artificial intelligence, and analytics to support monitoring, mapping, and operational decision-making.

product.name: Thuraya-4 Next Generation Satellite System
product.description: A next-generation L-band satellite communications system providing secure mobile connectivity across Europe, the Middle East and North Africa, Central Asia, and Africa.

product.name: Foresight Earth Observation Constellation
product.description: A satellite Earth-observation constellation using synthetic aperture radar satellites to provide imagery for monitoring and geospatial analysis.

product.name: YahClick Satellite Broadband
product.description: Satellite broadband services that provide internet connectivity to households, businesses, governments, and communities in areas with limited terrestrial broadband access.

product.name: Thuraya Mobile Satellite Communications
product.description: Mobile satellite voice and data communications for users operating across remote, maritime, aviation, government, and other areas with limited terrestrial coverage.
